translated_text: 24. f. 40 Ha my little wife, I received a gift from you to thank you very much for the 200 francs I have today, but it was truly inimitable. I have enough money, my dear, because I'm already short. Now, I'm definitely waiting for your medical certificate and then I'm leaving for Kignisic. My work is going well—I'm mainly doing amateur work. Because I don't enjoy it much, but I'm happy to have something. Later I'll work—for myself. And now I want to tell you that I have almost all the appearances—I found the cash register was invested but almost full. For 3 days I've been awake - In front of me there's a soldier who asks me, "Listen, I have a camera here - are you a photographer and can you tell me how much a camera like this costs today?" I found this camera on the road in a truck; it was my camera. It's almost unbelievable, but I'm already working with this camera, as did Jacques a little. I think I'll be demobilized and living by the end of the month in 10 days. It's no longer just a question of gas. We can always hope for more. We'll talk about other things together for any further [illegible]. I'm delighted to see you again soon and I send you a big hug. [Unclear] Madam #M. * D AP 18 ERASLY E.
